note: External Link Pop-up shows a confirmation dialog when a visitor clicks a link leaving the site. Pop-ups are external_link_popup config entities (fields id/name/status/weight/close/title/body[text_format]/labelyes/labelno/domains/new_tab). Global settings external_link_popup.settings hold whitelist (newline trusted domains), show_admin, width{value,units}. configure route external_link_popup.settings (/admin/config/content/external_link_popup/settings); pop-up CRUD at /admin/config/content/external_link_popup. Permission 'administer external link popup'. Domain matching: newline domains, domain.com matches *.domain.com, * matches all, weight order first match wins. Exclude a link with CSS class external-link-popup-disabled; force a pop-up with data-external-link-popup-id. No Drush, no plugin types. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config entities + external_link_popup.settings.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal external_link_popup module do, and where do you configure it (the settings route and the pop-up list page)?
evals.expected_output: It shows a confirmation dialog when a visitor clicks a link that leaves the site. Global settings are at route external_link_popup.settings (/admin/config/content/external_link_popup/settings) and pop-ups are managed at /admin/config/content/external_link_popup.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal external_link_popup module, how can I stop the pop-up from appearing for links to a whole trusted domain, and how can I stop it for one specific link?
evals.expected_output: Add the domain to the Trusted domains (whitelist) in external_link_popup.settings to skip a whole domain (matches subdomains too). For a single link, add the CSS class external-link-popup-disabled to the <a> element.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal external_link_popup module, how do I force a particular pop-up to be shown on a specific link (even a local one), and how does the module decide which pop-up applies to an external domain?
evals.expected_output: Add data-external-link-popup-id="<machine name>" to the link to force a specific pop-up (works for local links too, overriding domain matching except the disabled class). Otherwise pop-ups are matched by their Domains field (domain.com also matches *.domain.com, * matches all) in weight order, first match wins.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an external_link_popup pop-up with machine name elp_known. Inspect the live configuration and state which external domain(s) it targets and its dialog title.
evals.expected_output: elp_known targets the domain example.com and its title is 'Leaving For Example' (config external_link_popup.external_link_popup.elp_known: domains 'example.com').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the external_link_popup global settings have a trusted-domains whitelist configured. Inspect the live configuration and state which domain is currently whitelisted (exempt from pop-ups).
evals.expected_output: The whitelist in external_link_popup.settings is 'trusted-partner.test', so links to that domain (and its subdomains) show no pop-up.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new External Link Pop-up with machine name elp_task and label 'Task Popup', enabled, whose dialog title is exactly 'Warning' and which targets the external domain example.org. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An external_link_popup config entity elp_task exists (config external_link_popup.external_link_popup.elp_task), status enabled, title 'Warning', domains including example.org - created via the pop-up Add form or ExternalLinkPopup::create([...])->save().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure external_link_popup so that links to the domain trusted-charity.test never trigger a pop-up (add it to the trusted-domains whitelist). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The whitelist string in external_link_popup.settings now contains trusted-charity.test (set via the settings form Trusted domains field, or drush/config editing external_link_popup.settings:whitelist).
